basic_info.description: Flow & function unite in this unassuming duplex with all day indoor/outdoor living, an ideal flr plan, amazing natural light, & verdant outlooks, which lives like a single family home w/legal apt. Open the doors on a sunny morning to enjoy your paper & coffee on a deck with vistas towards the west & south, or enjoy the sparkling lights of Bernal Heights & Twin Peaks in the evening while cooking, dining, or entertaining w/friends. The top floor of this lovely property, nicely situated on the west slope of Potrero Hill, is a well laid out 3BR/2BA w/south & west facing open kitchen, living room w/fireplace, & dining room, all spilling to a sun filled wraparound deck off.  A lovely primary suite w/ample closet space & attached updated BA w/skylight, 2 additional well sized BRs, & a common BA, also w/skylight, hardwood floors, & fresh painting w/designer colors complete the level.  Downstairs, a charming one BR apartment w/independent access & attached deck is a perfect guest or office suite, or can provide excellent income. The property features a drought tolerant landscaped garden w/automatic drip irrigation, a well considered respite. Ample garage w/pkg for 2 cars side-by-side, storage, work area, & washer & dryer. Video intercom system w/remote functionality for easy deliveries.
